0.value:
The fifo_string node keeps a rolling window of the most recent phrases, older ones fading.

It holds as many phrases as its argument says, 4 by default, and pushes the oldest out as new ones arrive. That is what you want when feeding something that should be influenced more by what was just said than by what was said a minute ago - an image prompt, a mood, a running state.

HOW A MESSAGE BECOMES PHRASES:
A message to 'in' is split at its full stops into separate phrases (but not after Mr, Mrs, Dr or St), each ending in a full stop of its own. A message longer than 'length_threshold' characters is split at commas, colons, semicolons, question and exclamation marks as well, and each piece again gets a full stop.

WEIGHTS:
Each phrase carries a weight that starts at one and falls by 'decay_rate' per second, reaching zero after 100 seconds at the default 0.01. 'weighted out' sends every phrase with its weight; 'string out' sends the phrases whose weight is still above zero, as text.

The weights are only brought up to date when something arrives, so the window does not change while nothing is being said.

TEXT STILL BEING SPOKEN:
'progress' is for the partial text recognition sends while a phrase is still being spoken: it shows in the newest place, and is replaced there when the finished phrase arrives at 'in'.

SYNTAX:
fifo_string <count: int>

EXAMPLE:
fifo_string 6

INPUTS and PARAMETERS:

in:
Finished phrases.

progress:
Text still being spoken, held in the newest place.

clear:
Anything arriving here empties the window, and an empty window is sent.

dump_oldest:
Anything arriving here drops the oldest phrase and sends the window.

order:
newest_at_end (the default) or newest_at_start.

decay_rate / length_threshold:
How fast the weights fall, per second, and how long a message must be before it is split at every kind of punctuation.

OUTPUTS:

weighted out:
A list of phrase-and-weight pairs.

string out:
The phrases still above zero weight, as plain text, each followed by a space.

RELATED:
prompt_composer turns fifo_string's weighted phrases into an image prompt. gather_sentence assembles fragments into sentences to feed this node.
